text.title: AI Overview Presence Tracker Worked Example
text.summary: One complete 8-week report for a CRM vendor's 20-query set (rows shown for 4 of the 20 queries): fixed US mobile logged-out scrape, one missing week, citation by host match, presence 0.806 and citation 0.32 over the window, two co-occurrence findings and a two-entry retrofit list, with a note on each non-obvious value; then the report as it is usually written and what the validator prints.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: example-crm.com tracks 20 CRM queries against its guide pages from 2026-03-02 for eight weeks, scraped every Monday on US mobile through SE Ranking. In week 5 the Monday run was delayed a day; in week 4 the scrape for "crm with email sequences" timed out. The rows below are the four queries the retrofit decision turns on; the real report carries all 160.

example.note: Twenty queries mapped to guide pages under one `query_set_version`; the window is 56 days from `window_start` (r-fixed-versioned-query-set). `scrape_config` is US, English, mobile, logged out, and the AIO availability check was done before week 1 (r-fixed-locale-device-logged-out). Week 5's rows are dated 2026-03-31, one day after the scheduled Monday and inside the 48-hour tolerance; week 4 for "crm with email sequences" is `status: missing` with nulls, so that week's presence rate is 3 of 3 observed rather than 3 of 4 (r-weekly-same-day-no-interpolation, r-per-query-row-fields). Every present panel has at least one citation URL and a position; absent panels have empty citations and null position (r-per-query-row-fields). "crm for real estate agents" is cited because a citation URL's host is example-crm.com; "best crm for small business" is not, although the snippet talks about small-business CRMs (r-our-domain-cited-exact-host-match). The window metrics are 25 present of 31 observed = 0.806, 8 cited of 25 present = 0.32, and median position 1 over the 25 panels; the citation rate over 31 observed rows would have been 0.258 and is not what the rule asks for (r-report-metrics-presence-citation-position). Both findings name their metric and the period and describe the Search Console movement for the migration query as co-occurring (r-no-click-attribution-to-aio). The retrofit list holds "best crm for small business" (present 8 of 8, never cited, 48,200 impressions) and "crm with email sequences" (present 7 of the 7 observed weeks, uncited in weeks 5-8, 9,100 impressions), ranked by impressions, each with the domains the panel cites instead; "how to migrate from spreadsheets to crm" is excluded because its panel appeared in only 2 of 8 weeks (r-retrofit-priority-rule).
